subject: Proposal: runway extension + tiered credit carveout for RiseSeed cohort
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <procurement@riseseed.co>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Avery Labs <founders@averylabs.io>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cohort promo & runway — request for conditional top-up

Hi Logan,

Quick intro — I manage partnerships at RiseSeed. Our upcoming summer cohort (starts 2027-06-01) is lining up 14 startups that will evaluate Redwood over a 12-week curriculum. We previously agreed to a standard promo credit pool (120k tokens equivalent), but cohort leads flagged two risks: rapid early consumption and variable spike behavior during demo week.

Can Redwood provide a conditional runway extension option: if cohort consumption reaches >70% of the pool within first 4 weeks, we get a one-time top-up of 40% of the original credit? We'd prefer the top-up to be conditional (approval by email), with an option to convert any unused top-up to a committed discounted allocation for dedicated pricing after the cohort.

We attached a short workbook with projected cadence and a high-level SOW. Primary asks:
- Confirm whether a conditional top-up is possible
- Outline billing/fallback (convert to committed discount vs refund policy)
- Any lead time or legal hooks you need (DocuSign/SOW/manufactured invoice)

Appreciate a quick read — our cohort ops team needs a go/no-go by 4/28.

Thanks,
Alex Moreno
Partnerships | RiseSeed Accelerator
Attachment: RiseSeed_requirements.xlsx
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <procurement@riseseed.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cohort promo & runway — request for conditional top-up

Alex — thanks for the clear ask and the workbook. Short answer: yes, we can support a conditional top-up with a couple of guardrails. High level proposal below and attaching an internal pricing summary for transparency.

Proposal (summary):
- Baseline promo: existing 120k token-equivalent credit.
- Conditional top-up: +48k token-equivalent (40%) triggered if usage >70% in first 28 days.
- Top-up delivery: credited to the same account and valid for the remainder of the cohort period; any unused portion can be converted into a 6-month committed allocation at a 15% volume discount to be executed at cohort close.
- Billing/fallbacks: if cohort converts to Dedicated within 90 days, applied top-up reduces first-month committed invoice dollar-for-dollar. Otherwise, unused converted credit is invoiced as a discounted prepay per the conversion rate.
- Approvals: marketing/partnership sign-off by email OK; legal needs a short MOU/MA addendum; operations needs invoice path for a single consolidated invoice.

Ben/Kim — looping you for pricing and ops confirmation. Ben: is the 15% conversion discount defensible? Kim: can you confirm invoice routing and make sure we can cap overage spend to avoid surprise bills?

Alex — attaching: redwood-pricing-summary-v2.xlsx and a draft MAPlan stub (RiseSeed_MAPlan_v3.pdf). I can put together a DocuSign once Ben/Kim confirm the commercial bits.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Head of Launch Partnerships | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-pricing-summary-v2.xlsx, RiseSeed_MAPlan_v3.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Moreno <procurement@riseseed.co>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 10:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cohort promo & runway — request for conditional top-up

+1 to the conditional top-up in principle. A few commercial notes from my side:

- Discount on conversion: 15% is acceptable for a limited conversion window (we should gate it to startups that convert to paid in the first 90 days). For longer tail conversions we should step down the discount (e.g., 10% up to 6 months).
- Top-up sizing: 40% looks right for demo-week spikes, but request a usage cliff: top-up triggers only once (one-shot) and only at the account-level (not per-startup) to prevent double-dipping.
- Invoice path: one consolidated invoice to RiseSeed with line items: baseline promo (credit), conditional top-up (if triggered), and any committed-conversion prepay. Ops will need an internal memo showing expected timing.

I'll also ask GTM finance for a quick waiver if this becomes a recurring request for cohorts (we don't want to hard-code special terms across the product).

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <procurement@riseseed.co>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cohort promo & runway — request for conditional top-up

Alex — thanks, this is doable from an invoicing and ops standpoint. A few implementation details we suggest putting into the MOU addendum:

1) Trigger mechanics: ops will validate usage against the account-level consumption report on day 28; if >70% threshold met, Redwood issues an invoice credit for the top-up amount (0 USD charged) and posts the additional tokens to the account as an internal credit line.
2) Cap on overage: to avoid runaway spend, we will auto-block further tokens if projected month-end overage >2x baseline unless RiseSeed authorizes an explicit exception via email.
3) Conversion flow: at cohort close, RiseSeed provides a list of startups electing conversion; Redwood issues a single conversion invoice reflecting the applied 15% discount and the converted dollar amount.
4) Accounting note: to keep revenue recognition clean, the top-up counts as promotional credit until converted; finance prefers conversion to be reconciled within 45 days of cohort close.

Attached: a clean version of the pricing summary and a sample billing memo template. If that all looks good, Logan — I can spin the MOU addendum and DocuSign envelope.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-pricing-summary-v2.xlsx
From: Alex Moreno <procurement@riseseed.co>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Avery Labs <founders@averylabs.io>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cohort promo & runway — request for conditional top-up

Logan / Kimberly — this is great and aligns with how we operate. We accept the conditional one-shot top-up (48k token-equivalent) with the 70% day-28 trigger and the 15% conversion discount for conversions within 90 days. One ask: can we get the DocuSign envelope by EOD 4/30 so legal can sign and we can lock the cohort budget?

Also — please copy our cohort ops lead (ops@riseseed.co) on the final MOU. Once signed, we'll push the cohort SOW into the shared Drive.

Thanks again — excited to run this.

Best,
Alex Moreno
Partnerships | RiseSeed Accelerator
